[[2023 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] champions | tourney = [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] | tourney_result =Elite Eight }} {{2022–23 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team''' represented [[Gonzaga University]], located in [[Spokane, Washington]], in the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team, also unofficially nicknamed the "Zags", was led by head coach [[Mark Few]], in his 24th season as head coach, and played home games at the on-campus [[McCarthey Athletic Center]] as members of the [[West Coast Conference]] (WCC). The Zags finished the regular season 26–5, 14–2 in [[2022–23 West Coast Conference men's basketball season|WCC play]], to win a share of the regular season championship. They defeated [[2022–23 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team|San Francisco]] in the semifinals of the [[2023 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] before defeating [[2022–23 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]] to win the WCC championship. They received an automatic bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], where they defeated [[2022–23 Grand Canyon Antelopes men's basketball team|Grand Canyon]], [[2022–23 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]], and [[2022–23 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]] to advance to the Elite Eight. There they lost to [[2022–23 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]] to finish their season 31–6. On January 19, 2023, the Zags lost to [[2022–23 Loyola Marymount Lions men's basketball team|Loyola Marymount]] at the McCarthey Athletic Center, ending their 76-game home winning streak, which was the longest in the nation at the time.{{Cite web |date=2023-01-20 |agency=The Associated Press |title=LMU halts Gonzaga's 76-game home win streak |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/35486005 |access-date=2023-01-20 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} == Previous season == {{Main|2021–22 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team}} The [[2021–22 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 28–4, 13–1 in [[2021–22 West Coast Conference men's basketball season|WCC play]], to win the regular season championship. They defeated [[2021–22 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team|San Francisco]] and [[2021–22 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]] in the [[2022 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] to win the tournament championship. As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 1 seed in the West region.{{Cite web |last=Marshall
